context_title:
-- Exact integer Jacobian samples for a batch of polynomial maps.
-- A map is flattened as [P coefficients, Q coefficients].
-- The exponent table is flattened as [x0,y0,x1,y1,...].

let power (x: i64) (e: i64): i64 =
  loop result = 1 for _i < e do result * x

let derivative_x (coefficients: []i64) (component: i64) (x: i64) (y: i64) (exponents: []i64) (n_coeffs: i64): i64 =
  let indices = iota n_coeffs
  in reduce (+) 0 (map (\i ->
    let coefficient = coefficients[component * n_coeffs + i]
    let exponent_x = exponents[2 * i]
    let exponent_y = exponents[2 * i + 1]
    in if exponent_x == 0 then 0
    else coefficient * exponent_x * power x (exponent_x - 1) * power y exponent_y) indices)

let derivative_y (coefficients: []i64) (component: i64) (x: i64) (y: i64) (exponents: []i64) (n_coeffs: i64): i64 =
  let indices = iota n_coeffs
  in reduce (+) 0 (map (\i ->
    let coefficient = coefficients[component * n_coeffs + i]
    let exponent_x = exponents[2 * i]
    let exponent_y = exponents[2 * i + 1]
    in if exponent_y == 0 then 0
    else coefficient * exponent_y * power x exponent_x * power y (exponent_y - 1)) indices)

let jacobian_at (coefficients: []i64) (point: []i64) (exponents: []i64) (n_coeffs: i64): i64 =
  let x = point[0]
  let y = point[1]
  let p_x = derivative_x coefficients 0 x y exponents n_coeffs
  let p_y = derivative_y coefficients 0 x y exponents n_coeffs
  let q_x = derivative_x coefficients 1 x y exponents n_coeffs
  let q_y = derivative_y coefficients 1 x y exponents n_coeffs
  in p_x * q_y - p_y * q_x

entry jacobian_samples (maps: []i64) (points: []i64) (exponents: []i64) (n_coeffs: i64): []i64 =
  let n_maps = length maps / (2 * n_coeffs)
  let n_points = length points / 2
  let map_ids = iota n_maps
  let point_ids = iota n_points
  in flatten (map (\map_id ->
    let coefficients = maps[map_id * (2 * n_coeffs) : (map_id + 1) * (2 * n_coeffs)]
    in map (\point_id ->
      let point = points[point_id * 2 : (point_id + 1) * 2]
      in jacobian_at coefficients point exponents n_coeffs) point_ids) map_ids)

def power (x: i64) (e: i64): i64 =
  loop result = 1i64 for _i < e do result * x

def derivative_x
  (maps: []i64)
  (map_id: i64)
  (component: i64)
  (x: i64)
  (y: i64)
  (exponents: []i64)
  (n_coeffs: i64): i64 =
  reduce (+) 0i64
    (map (\i ->
      let coefficient = maps[map_id * (2 * n_coeffs) + component * n_coeffs + i]
      let exponent_x = exponents[2 * i]
      let exponent_y = exponents[2 * i + 1]
      in if exponent_x == 0i64 then 0i64
         else coefficient * exponent_x
              * power x (exponent_x - 1i64)
              * power y exponent_y)
      (iota n_coeffs))

def derivative_y
  (maps: []i64)
  (map_id: i64)
  (component: i64)
  (x: i64)
  (y: i64)
  (exponents: []i64)
  (n_coeffs: i64): i64 =
  reduce (+) 0i64
    (map (\i ->
      let coefficient = maps[map_id * (2 * n_coeffs) + component * n_coeffs + i]
      let exponent_x = exponents[2 * i]
      let exponent_y = exponents[2 * i + 1]
      in if exponent_y == 0i64 then 0i64
         else coefficient * exponent_y
              * power x exponent_x
              * power y (exponent_y - 1i64))
      (iota n_coeffs))

def jacobian_at
  (maps: []i64)
  (map_id: i64)
  (x: i64)
  (y: i64)
  (exponents: []i64)
  (n_coeffs: i64): i64 =
  let p_x = derivative_x maps map_id 0i64 x y exponents n_coeffs
  let p_y = derivative_y maps map_id 0i64 x y exponents n_coeffs
  let q_x = derivative_x maps map_id 1i64 x y exponents n_coeffs
  let q_y = derivative_y maps map_id 1i64 x y exponents n_coeffs
  in p_x * q_y - p_y * q_x

entry jacobian_samples
  (maps: []i64)
  (points: []i64)
  (exponents: []i64)
  (n_coeffs: i64): []i64 =
  assert (n_coeffs > 0i64)
    (assert (length exponents % 2i64 == 0i64 &&
             length exponents / 2i64 == n_coeffs)
      (assert (length points % 2i64 == 0i64)
        (assert (reduce (&&) true (map (\e -> e >= 0i64) exponents))
          (assert (length maps % (2i64 * n_coeffs) == 0i64)
            (let n_maps = length maps / (2i64 * n_coeffs)
             let n_points = length points / 2i64
             in flatten
                  (map (\map_id ->
                    map (\point_id ->
                      let x = points[2i64 * point_id]
                      let y = points[2i64 * point_id + 1i64]
                      in jacobian_at maps map_id x y exponents n_coeffs)
                    (iota n_points))
                  (iota n_maps))))))
